collection.title: Alfa Romeo 33 1990 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Alfa Romeo 33 1990 to 1995 model requires a 19" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this model, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
